The rich, creamy texture and deep, nutty flavour make it an ideal ingredient for preparing a wide variety of dishes, from classic hummus and dips to dressings, sandwiches, and Eastern-inspired sweets like halawa. The tahini is packaged in a securely sealed jar that preserves its natural consistency, freshness, and flavour for longer. Simply stir before use to restore its natural texture. Store in a cool, dry place for best results. Whether you are whipping up a quick dip or adding depth to your favourite recipes, Zaadana Organic Sesame Tahini is a versatile and nutritious addition to any kitchen. For daily care, apply a suitable amount to the scalp, massage gently for 5-10 minutes, then rinse after two hours. As an oil bath treatment, distribute the oil throughout your hair from roots to ends, cover with a warm towel for 30-60 minutes before washing. To moisturise the ends, apply a few drops to hair tips after washing to maintain their softness and shine. For scalp care, massage a small amount into the scalp three times per week. Originating from Saudi Arabia, this natural herbal care formula supports a healthy daily hair routine. Store in a cool and dry place to preserve its quality. Almarwani Sahlab with Nuts is a premium quality traditional hot beverage that brings the warmth and comfort of a classic Middle Eastern drink right to your home. This creamy, indulgent drink is beloved across the region, especially during cooler weather and special gatherings. Made with a rich, smooth powder that blends effortlessly, it delivers a uniquely satisfying texture complemented by the delightful crunch of natural nuts. Each 400g tin provides multiple servings and is incredibly easy to prepare. Simply mix two large spoonfuls of the sahlab powder with half a cup of sugar, then in a small pot, combine four cups of water with a little sahlab powder to form a smooth paste. Gradually add the mixture to warm milk while stirring continuously, and keep stirring vigorously for at least 7 minutes over a gentle heat until the drink reaches a thick, creamy consistency.
